headline: Pentair plc (PNR) Tops Q2 Earnings Estimates
summary: Pentair (PNR) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +1.79% and -7.84%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
